subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Amazon Bedrock expose a broad per-model `additionalModelRequestFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix creates a user-facing provider config contract and repository policy treats provider routing/config surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields and covers `anthropic_beta` without making core generic config responsible for vendor payloads.

options.title: Add only a typed beta option
options.body: Support a narrower Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long context while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature before users can opt in.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields and covers `anthropic_beta` without making core generic config responsible for vendor payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available current-main routing candidate from blame on the Bedrock provider runtime files; final product ownership may still need a maintainer with provider-config authority.
